title: E2E Framework + Core Scenarios
description:
Implement E2E test framework and core scenarios from docs/plans/08-agent-tools-e2e.md.

Sections: §2 (Architecture), §3 (Test Suite Design), §4.1-§4.4 + §4.6-§4.8 (Core Scenarios), §6 (Acceptance Criteria)

Key deliverables:
- Test harness framework: harness/runner.go, observer.go, oracles.go, fixtures/
- Deterministic fake provider traces for PR-level runs
- Optional real provider mode (credential-gated)
- Assertion layers: event-level, conversation-level, filesystem/process-level
- Scenario 4.1: Multi-turn local file refactor
- Scenario 4.2: Bash build-and-fix loop
- Scenario 4.3: Steering mid-turn
- Scenario 4.4: Follow-up queue chain
- Scenario 4.6: Terminal tool completion
- Scenario 4.7: Git read workflow
- Scenario 4.8: Error recovery workflow
- CI tier integration with Makefile targets

Required reading: docs/plans/00-implementation-guide.md
See Implementation Guide §5 (Seam: e2etests ↔ internal/agent + internal/tools)

References:
- Plan: docs/plans/08-agent-tools-e2e.md §2-§4, §6
- Test harness: docs/plans/08-agent-tools-e2e-test-harness.md
- Depends on: T2 (Agent Loop) + T5 (Search/Bash/Git Tools)
